newsitem.title: UK: UK's BAA November air cargo up 8.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: UK's BAA November air cargo up 8.2 pct.

text.p: Britain's BAA Plc said on Thursday that total air cargo tonnage rose by 8.2 percent in November to 133,563 metric tonnes -- the largest monthly total ever handled at its seven UK airports.
The company said cargo tonnage at Heathrow rose 4.0 percent versus the same month a year ago, while Gatwick and Stansted improved by 17.9 and 27.2 percent, respectively.
Cargo for the total London area rose 8.2 percent in November, BAA said in its statement.
Elsewhere, cargo at Edinburgh jumped 50 percent, while Glasgow fell 10.4 percent.
